title: Prospective comparison of real-SWAP phreatic storage response and current mode-5 finite-window u
activation_rule: Execute only after GC_HLINK04_RESULT.json exists and records qualified INSIDE_SAFE and BELOW_SAFE characterization under the preregistered immutable-origin gates.
Do not change HLINK04 controls, dt or finite-difference scales in response to HLINK04 observations.

comparison_scope.primary: BELOW_SAFE only, because H_phreatic maps exactly to mode-5 hbot through declared bottom-face geometry and therefore both response families can be evaluated at the same immutable origin and control coordinate.
comparison_scope.secondary: INSIDE_SAFE is retained only as phreatic-response characterization; no current mode-5 u equality test is defined there because the control coordinates are not the same physical boundary state.

J_Q.definition: dt * central finite-difference d(qbot)/dH_phreatic from HLINK04 BELOW_SAFE

u_mode5.definition: dt / (dHbot/dqbot) from the current accepted-trajectory mode-5 response machinery evaluated from the same immutable origin, same dt and same constitutive/process configuration
u_mode5.interpretation: current production finite-window response coefficient; not assumed a priori to be storage

preregistered_identities_to_test.statement: For the process-free BELOW_SAFE window, J_S + J_Q = 0 within the independently declared finite-difference/numerical error envelope.
preregistered_identities_to_test.rationale: Window mass balance gives DeltaS = qbot*dt when qtop=0 under the LOW01-A2 sign convention; differentiating with respect to H_phreatic yields equal-and-opposite storage and bottom-exchange sensitivities.

preregistered_identities_to_test.statement: Compare u_mode5 with J_S and -J_Q at delta=0.01 cm and delta=0.1 cm without assuming equality.
preregistered_identities_to_test.decision_rule: Report relative and absolute differences at both scales. Equality is supported only if both scales agree within 1e-4 relative and the sign conventions are independently consistent.

required_outputs: HLINK04 BELOW_SAFE J_S at delta=0.01 and 0.1 cm
HLINK04 BELOW_SAFE J_Q at delta=0.01 and 0.1 cm
independent mode-5 u_mode5 from the same origin/window
repeatability and provenance of all three objects
gates: same immutable origin, constitutive provider, dt and process configuration are proven for HLINK04 BELOW_SAFE and the mode-5 u evaluation
H_phreatic-to-hbot mapping is exactly one-to-one with derivative dhbot/dH_phreatic=1 in the BELOW_SAFE branch
J_S+J_Q mass-derivative identity closes at both preregistered scales within the declared error envelope
all comparisons are reported without retuning finite-difference deltas or solver tolerances
no equality claim is extended to INSIDE_SAFE
interpretation_rules: If u_mode5 approximately equals J_S and -J_Q in BELOW_SAFE, this supports a bounded local equivalence of the finite-window response objects under the below-profile mode-5/H_phreatic coordinate mapping.
Such a match does not make u_mode5 a universal static Sy; MAP10 already establishes strong window dependence.
Such a match does not establish shared-volume ownership with MODFLOW STO; geometric storage ownership remains a separate contract.
If u_mode5 differs materially from J_S while mass-derivative closure J_S+J_Q holds, investigate accepted-trajectory sensitivity construction before changing any coupling physics.
forbidden: no comparison across different immutable origins or coupling windows
no use of INSIDE_SAFE to claim mode-5 equivalence
no relabeling of u_mode5 as static specific yield
next_if_qualified: Use the result to define HLINK06 N:1 aggregation of separately measured storage and process responses.
Only after explicit geometric ownership is declared may a later HLINK experiment map the real-SWAP storage response into MODFLOW STO/API representation.
